description: PiggyTask helps parents organize kids’ chores with coins and rewards. Connect once with OAuth, then ask ChatGPT to list children, create mandatory or bonus tasks, assign pool tasks, or mark chores done. Access stays scoped to the family you approve and can be revoked anytime in PiggyTask settings. PiggyTask is independent and not affiliated with OpenAI.

defaultPrompt: List the kids in our PiggyTask family.
Create a mandatory chore "Take out the trash" for Alex.
Add a 5-coin bonus task "Tidy the living room" to the PiggyTask pool.
